digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: Define a factory protocol and immutable route registry that can describe CLI routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.
Registry construction and route lookup must not trigger imports of handler modules or optional packages like pydantic_ai.
Provide deterministic help output, parse error handling, and validation of duplicate spellings, illegal aliases, contradictory policies, and malformed references without resolving handlers.
Derived policy-set exports from routes must achieve zero shadow-census delta against current command sets and maintain backward-compatibility help/execution paths.
Route records hold lazy handler/parser-factory references plus metadata for identity, aliases, visibility, help, confirmation, output, and capability tracking.
